prompt: Navy plants a garden behind the school
title: School Garden Treats
irony: Navy gives every seed away to be kind and leaves his garden bare, until keeping one patch and tending it daily grows treats for all.

beats.title: The street wakes
beats.summary: Navy and Green pat flat brown dirt behind the big house with tiny spades under bright sun.

beats.title: The setup
beats.summary: Navy wants a school garden to gift tomatoes to all, and believes Black's tale of overnight candy corn.

beats.title: The setup builds
beats.summary: Black bets the garden cannot sprout by Friday, so Navy hands out all his seeds as promise treats.

beats.title: The hook
beats.summary: Navy, Green, Black and Blue chant and pat seeded rows with painted signs.

beats.title: The problem
beats.summary: Blue drags in a huge grow-machine that thumps and squashes the new sprouts flat in mud.

beats.title: The problem builds
beats.summary: The sprinkler spins wild and soaks all four, and Navy slips into a muddy puddle laughing.

beats.title: The hook again
beats.summary: Navy, Green, Black and Blue chant again, wiping mud while tiny green sprouts peek out.

beats.title: The turn
beats.summary: Blue and Gray kneel by flat sprouts at dusk and admit big bought things cannot hurry roots.

beats.title: The turn deepens
beats.summary: Blue trades the machine for watering cans and starts daily care with Navy and Green.

beats.title: The hook, grown
beats.summary: On the street the crew sings the hook as Blue lifts a ripe red tomato high.

beats.title: Settle down
beats.summary: The crew shares tomatoes on the street and tends one kept patch that feeds all.
